settings.lede: Two people, a booked slot, and the bed carried to the room you want it in. Here is exactly what happens between your order and your first night's sleep.

settings.title: Order confirmed
settings.text: We confirm your size and fabric by email the same working day, so nothing is cut until you have checked it.

settings.title: Made for you
settings.text: Your frame is cut, sprung and upholstered to order in our workshop. Nothing sits in a warehouse waiting.

settings.title: Slot booked
settings.text: We call to agree a delivery day and give you a two-hour window the night before.

settings.title: Carried in and set up
settings.text: Two people bring it to your room of choice, assemble it, and take every scrap of packaging away with them.

settings.heading: From our workshop to your bedroom
settings.note: Free delivery to most of mainland UK. Some Scottish highland, island and Northern Ireland postcodes carry a surcharge, shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.title: Handmade in Britain
settings.note: Built to order in our own workshop

settings.title: 10-year guarantee
settings.note: On the frame of every bed we make

settings.title: Free UK delivery
settings.note: Two people, to your room of choice

settings.question: Do you take the old bed away?
settings.answer: We can, for a fee added at checkout, provided it is dismantled and clear of bedding when we arrive. Tell us when you book your slot rather than on the day, so the crew arrive with room in the van.

settings.question: What if nobody is in?
settings.answer: We give you a two-hour window the night before and call ahead on the day. If the slot no longer works, tell us as early as you can and we will rebook at no cost. A missed delivery with no notice carries a redelivery charge.

settings.question: Will they assemble it?
settings.answer: Yes, and it is included. The crew build the bed in the room of your choice, check it over, and take all the packaging away with them.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside mainland UK?
settings.answer: We deliver to Northern Ireland, the Scottish highlands and most islands. Those postcodes carry a surcharge, which is calculated and shown at checkout before you pay — there are no charges added afterwards.
